fact: The Plan National de Développement 2024-2028 (dated 31 August 2024) refers to the Plan National Stratégique Centrafrique Digitale 2025 as the framework for catalysing digital transformation between 2024 and 2028, and lists it as a Ministry of Posts and Telecommunications document of November 2020, 70 pages.
title: PND-RCA 2024-2028
publisher: Ministère de l'Economie, du Plan et de la Coopération Internationale
